app.name: Authio
app.tagline: Your keys, your device. Offline. Encrypted. Open source.

setup.title: Set up your vault
setup.intro: All your secrets are encrypted with AES-256-GCM and never leave this device. Choose how the encryption key is protected:
setup.mode.password.desc: Strongest protection. The key is derived with Argon2id — without the password, nothing can be decrypted.
setup.mode.keychain.desc: Most convenient. A random key is stored in the Windows Credential Manager and unlocked with your Windows session.

lock.title: Welcome back
lock.subtitle.password: Enter your master password to unlock your codes.
lock.subtitle.keychain: Your vault unlocks with your Windows session.

main.empty.title: No accounts yet
main.empty.hint: Add one manually, scan a QR image, or import from Google Authenticator, Aegis or Authme.

delete.title: Delete account?
delete.msg: This permanently removes “{issuer} / {name}”. Make sure you have another way to sign in.

add.title: Add account
add.qr.hint: Select a screenshot or photo of a QR code (PNG or JPEG). Google Authenticator export QRs are supported.
add.uri.label: Paste an otpauth:// URI
add.manual.name: Account name
add.manual.hint: The secret is the Base32 string shown next to the QR code when enabling 2FA.

import.title: Import accounts
import.file.hint: Authio backups, Aegis vaults (auth files), Authme exports and otpauth text lists are supported.
import.text.label: Paste backup contents or otpauth:// URIs
import.password.title: This backup is encrypted
import.password.hint: Enter the password protecting this backup file.
import.preview.title: Review import

export.title: Export backup
export.encrypted.desc: Protected with its own passphrase (Argon2id + AES-256-GCM).
export.plain.desc: Readable by anyone. Use only for migration into another trusted app.
export.plain.warn: This file will contain ALL your secrets in plain text.

settings.title: Settings
settings.about: Authio {v} — MIT licensed. No internet, no telemetry. Secrets never leave this device.
